entities.name: man on the bank pointing east to the moored boats
entities.what: Man with dark hair or a dark cap and a light robe standing on the river bank behind (north of) the tea house, at the water's edge by the biggest boat's stern, his right arm stretched out east at shoulder height with a short thin thing or a pointing hand at its end, toward the rafted boats and the water; only head and shoulders show above the round canopy in front of him.
entities.vis: part: below the chest hidden by the round canopy S4b.prop.round_canopy_14905 and the tea house roof
entities.src: 余辉: 客家登船? (setting, unconfirmed)
entities.note: Head u 14917-14940, v 806-821; shoulders and body u 14912-14945, v 820-838; arm from (14940, 825) to (14978, 828), a second line down from (14945, 828) may be the other arm. Foot hidden: est 96 px below the head top (t4's bank figures are 61-69 px at foot v 401-406, the gate figure about 85 px at v 692, the tea house's seated men 112-126 px at v 1175). A lighter patch at the head's west side may be his face turned back west while he points east (the restyle paints a dark-haired head facing east and a second light face beside it: the scan has one head). BANK: the shore wash runs from about (14900, 780) to (15000, 840) north and east of him; ripple strokes at (15000-15080, 820-850). The bank top under him is hidden (est v ~900). t4's report lists 'a figure leaning at a table with one arm out to the east at about u 14930-14975, v 860-910': this is the same man.

entities.name: man at the tea house's east bay (seated or standing)
entities.what: Man in a light robe in the tea house's east bay, just east of its post, face turned toward the viewer and slightly east; read here as seated and leaning back with his knees drawn up, a reddish-brown oval at his lap (red trousers or a red cloth over his knees); he may instead be standing on the floor at the back of the bay with a red apron or bundle at his hips.
entities.vis: part: lower body crossed by braces and branches
entities.note: Face u 14954-14969, v 1022-1040 (eyes and nose drawn), hair or cap v 1008-1022; body u 14927-14990, v 1035-1100; reddish oval u 14938-14975, v 1068-1090; crossing lines below at u 14935-14990, v 1090-1150 (legs, bench legs or the bay's braces). Painted height 117 px to the est foot, which fits t4's seated customers (112-126 px) and a standing man alike. Two readings: seated with the knees up (the restyle paints him reclining in red trousers; this map takes seated) or standing (the setup agent and t4 read a light standing figure). A third reading: standing and holding a round reddish tray or basin at his waist (a tea-house waiter). Foot est at v 1125 for all; the tea house floor's front edge is at v ~1195-1200 here, so he is at the back of the bay. The restyle's 'dark-clad figure bending' at u 14830-14880 is not on the scan (posts and diagonals) and is not recorded.

entities.name: man in a dark cap seen from behind on the road
entities.what: Man in a dark rounded cap and a plain robe, seen from behind, standing on the road at the tea house's east end in front of its long table, facing north-east toward the man under the big frame or hat (S4b.fig.man_frame_or_hat_15125), as if talking with him.
entities.vis: part: feet hidden behind the south row's roof ridge (v ~1250)
entities.note: Head (cap) u 15060-15090, v 1145-1165; shoulders v ~1172; body u 15045-15105 down to v 1247 where the roof ridge cuts it. Foot est just below the ridge. Painted height 115 px to the est foot. The restyle paints him in blue with a black cap, the same pose.

entities.name: man under a big roof-like frame or hat, on the road
entities.what: Man in a light robe standing on the road at the tea house's east end, face turned toward the viewer and west to the man in the dark cap; over his head is a wide, tilted, roof-like shape (peaked at its west end, sloping down to the east) with long strokes hanging from its east edge down past his shoulder: a tall wooden frame, chair or pedlar's rack carried on his back, or a very wide hat with a veil or straw cape hanging from its brim.
entities.vis: part: feet hidden behind the south row's roof ridge (v ~1250)
entities.note: Face u 15105-15130, v 1130-1155 (eyes drawn), a dark band (hair or headband) at v 1122-1130; robe u 15100-15150 down to v ~1248 with fold lines. THE SHAPE OVER HIM: outline from a peak at (15102, 1078) along the top to about (15140, 1088) and down to (15177, 1118), bottom edge v 1120-1125 from 15100 to 15177, a vertical line inside at u 15135 (77 px wide, about 3 times his face's width); long hanging strokes from its east edge at u 15150-15180 down to v ~1200-1220 (the restyle's 'legs' and 'bundle'). Three readings, low for each: (a) a wooden frame, chair or rack carried on his back, its legs sticking out behind him (the restyle's reading; then pose carrying); (b) a very wide tilted hat (斗笠-like) with a veil or straw cape hanging at its east side; (c) a small roofed stand on the ground behind him (base about (15150, 1200)), which would be a prop of its own. The figure itself is certain. Painted height 138 px from the hair to the est foot, taller than the man in the dark cap (115 px): he may stand a little nearer the viewer. Feet hidden behind the south row's roof ridge (v ~1250). MERGE: structures_e independently read the shape over him as "a stall with a slanted top under the mat shed, 15100-15180, v 1080-1165" (reading c). On the merge agent's crop (scratchpad S4b_merge/c_frame.jpg) the long strokes hanging from its east edge end at about v 1220, some 40 px above the ground he stands on (feet est ~1260): legs of a frame carried on his back (reading a) rather than a stand on the ground, so no stall prop is added. Readings (a) and (b) stay.

entities.name: two men meeting on the road at the tea house's east end
entities.what: On the road below the willow's long branch, a man in a dark cap seen from behind faces a man in a light robe under a big roof-like frame or hat, who turns his face toward him: two men stopped to talk, perhaps a pedlar with his rack.
entities.note: The long table S4b.prop.long_table_15050 stands just behind (north of) them, under the tea house's east eave.

entities.name: big round canopy (parasol?) behind the tea house
entities.what: A big round, low-domed canopy with ribs radiating from its top, standing behind (north of) the tea house's east roof and the mat shed's west end, its lower rim hidden by their roofs: a large round mat parasol whose pole is hidden, or a rounded roof that is part of the tea house.
entities.vis: part: lower edge and any pole hidden by the tea house roof
entities.note: Dome u 14784-15034, v 838-900 (250 px across), radial rib strokes from the apex at about (14900, 840); its lower rim meets the tea house roof's back edge at v 884-900, where the crosshatched roof (u 14880-15190, v 900-1020) begins. Recorded under the in-between rule (a canopy on its own pole is a tile prop) but the geometry argues against a free-standing parasol: a pole of about 2.2 m from a rim at v 897 would reach the ground at about v 1040, below the hall's front eave (v 1020), and no pole shows there. Second reading, preferred by that geometry: a rounded (umbrella-like or mat) roof that is part of the tea house, structures_e's; the restyle paints it as the tiled upper part of the tea house roof. If the merge keeps the structures_e reading, retire this prop. Base est (centre, hidden behind the roof). SCALE CUE: 250 px across at v ~870. MERGE: structures_e recorded the same canopy as S4b.prop.parasol_14872 (retired as a duplicate): dome u 14787-15033, top v ~840, lower edge v ~900, ribs converging near (14903, 843); it saw a pole stroke below it at u 14870-14877 (v 903-937), in line with the tea house's post at 14864-14875 (v 1014-1180), and put its base at that post's foot (14872, 1180, est). The merge agent's crop (scratchpad S4b_merge/c_parasol.jpg) shows the rim running along the mat roof's top edge, so the canopy stands behind that roof; the base is kept here, behind it. Readings, all low: (a) a big round mat parasol standing on the bank behind the roof, its pole hidden (structures_e; the man pointing at the boats stands just behind it); (b) a parasol fixed on the tea house's east post (structures_e's base); (c) a rounded roof of the tea house (t5's preference; the restyle paints a tiled dome). Built once either way.

entities.name: long low table under the tea house's east eave
entities.what: Long, low wooden table (or a long bench) under the tea house's east eave, east of the man in the east bay; a slatted box stands on its east end (S4b.prop.slatted_box_15078); the willow's drooping branch hangs just above its west end.
entities.vis: part: east end behind the man in the dark cap
entities.note: Back edge of the top v 1130-1135 from u ~14980 to 15095, front edge v ~1155 from 15000 to 15055 (the east part is hidden by S4b.fig.man_dark_cap_15075); front-west leg u 15012-15018, v 1150-1190. Base = middle of the footprint, est. SCALE CUE: front edge to the leg foot about 35 px (about 0.45 m at 77 px/m: a low table or a bench); length about 100 px visible. The restyle paints a long table with pots on it and, in the branches above, 'white animal-like shapes' (u 15000-15040, v 1080-1150): the scan has the branch's upright budding twigs there and no animals.

entities.name: slatted box on the long table
entities.what: Small box-like frame with vertical slats (a crate, a cage or a little rack) standing on the east end of the long table under the tea house's eave.
entities.vis: part: lower edge behind the table top
entities.note: Box u 15060-15095, v 1100-1130, vertical slat strokes inside. Base = its bottom at the table top's back edge. It may instead be a slatted panel of the tea house's back wall or a rack behind the table (then structures_e's). The restyle paints a blue container with things on it here.

entities.name: small square box in the tea house's east bay
entities.what: Small square box or frame (a box, a little lantern or a stool seen end on) in the tea house's east bay, just west of the bay's post, raised above the floor.
entities.note: Square u 14905-14924, v 1141-1161 with an inner square (u 14910-14920, v 1146-1158). Its bottom is about 37 px (about 0.45 m) above the floor line (v ~1195-1200): it sits on a bench hidden among the bay's diagonal members, or hangs. Base = the floor straight below it, est. The restyle paints a dark object here (part of its invented bending figure).

entities.name: timber or low rail along the bank's lip (faint)
entities.what: A long, slightly curved double-lined band lying along the river bank's lip east of the tea house roof, from the mat shed roof's top east corner east into the willow's whips: the bank's lip, a log or timber edging laid along the bank, or a branch of the willow.
entities.note: Band about 10 px thick from (15160, 903-910) curving east to (15240, 915-925), fading at about (15270, 935) into the willow's whips; the west end's down-stroke runs u 15158-15166, v 902-930 (base = its foot). Water lies north of it (a ripple curl at 15200-15230, v 870-885). Readings: (a) the bank's own lip, drawn as its top edge and end face (then it is the river agent's bank_top line and this prop is dropped); (b) a log or timber edging lying on the bank; (c) a low rail on a post at its west end, perhaps a mooring rail (the restyle paints a low rail with a post at (15158, 898-940)). If it stands in the water's edge it is the river agent's. SECOND PASS: the "west end turning down like a short post" (u 15158-15166, v 902-930) is the top of S4b.bld.mat_shed_15038's east verge ((15147, 897) -> (15197, 1000)), so reading (c), a low rail on a post, has no post and is dropped. The band (about 10 px thick, (15157, 906) -> (15200, 911) -> (15240, 918), fading into the willow's whips at about (15265, 928)) runs near the line of the shed's ridge. Remaining readings, all low: (a) the bank's lip behind the shed (the river agent's est bank_top passes 5-15 px north of it); (b) a log or timber on the bank; (d) a branch of S4b.tree.willow_15468. Base moved to the band's middle (was the verge's foot (15162, 930)); top_w removed. Crops scratchpad S4b_second_east/z_timber.jpg, ow_timber.jpg.

entities.name: small bench at the top shop's table
entities.what: Small low wooden bench standing just east of the table in the open front of the shop at the top of the silk, west of the moorings; empty.
entities.note: Top u 14846-14873, v 165-178; legs at u ~14850 and ~14868 to v 182-187. Next to t4's S4b.prop.table_14830 (top u 14802-14860), whose east legs stand at u 14848-14852: if the merge finds this is the table's east end, drop it. The restyle draws a bench here. SCALE CUE: about 20 px tall at foot v 186.

entities.name: old willow by the road at the moorings (seam willow)
entities.what: Big old bare willow with a massive, gnarled, knotted trunk rising from behind the south row's roofs by the road and forking: the east leader climbs north-east past the biggest moored boat's bow, its branches crossing in front of the boat's deck house; the west leader leans north-west to a knot at about (15350, 1070), from which a long, nearly level limb runs west over the road to the tea house's east end and droops there to about v 1110; long fine whips fan out west and up from the crown (u 15230-15450) and hang down between the leaders. No leaves.
entities.vis: part: foot hidden behind the south row's roofs; east part of the crown past u 15500 (S3)
entities.note: TRUNK: the east leader is a broad dark band from (15450-15510, 1250) up through (15500-15530, 1070-1100) and (15520-15560, 900-1000) to (15550-15600, 740-850), branching over the biggest boat (branch tips to about (15455, 620)); the west leader is the dark slanted band from about (15400, 1170) up to (15350, 1095); they meet behind the roofs near (15440-15480, 1250-1300). Foot est where the trunk passes behind the roof ridges (v 1215-1250; the gable at (15500, 1304)), at the road's south edge. LONG WEST LIMB: from the knot (15350, 1065) through (15287, 1037), (15247, 1013), (15200, 1010), (15100, 1023), then drooping through (15080, 1050) and (15050, 1090) to (14995, 1110), with upright budding shoots at u 15000-15060, v 1040-1100; a short branch hangs from the limb at u 15156-15164 to v 1092; from the limb's bend at about (15105, 1020) an upright branch climbs over the tea house roof's east end to about v 885, twigging out at u 15060-15140, v 885-950 (the restyle paints the same). WHIPS: a fan of fine strokes at u 15230-15450, v 870-1010, from a head near (15400, 1000); fine hanging whips at u 15400-15500, v 1000-1200 (thin vertical lines that look like slender stems). CROWN EAST: twigs and a long branch run east past the seam to about u 15720 (v 750-900), in front of S3's riverside hall. Two readings of the trunk count: one tree with two leaders (taken here; the restyle paints the same) or two trees, the west leader standing on its own at about u 15400-15430. The arching stem at u 15290-15370 is recorded as a separate young tree (S4b.tree.young_tree_15275), which may instead be a drooping bough of this willow. SEAM (S3): the trunk is S4b's; its crown reaches over S3's riverside hall to about u 15720. The restyle leafs it green.

entities.name: young bare tree between the south roofs
entities.what: Young bare tree with upright, budding twigs (not willow whips) rising from the gap between two south-row roofs at the road's south edge; its slender stem leans and arches north-east into the old willow's crown.
entities.vis: part: foot hidden behind the roofs
entities.note: Stem from the gap between the roof with the ridge ornament at (15215, 1240) and the gabled roof whose west edge runs from (15325, 1217) down to (15304, 1358): visible at u 15275-15300, v 1210-1310, then arching through (15305, 1220), (15320, 1140), (15345, 1090) to (15365, 1062), where it meets the willow's knot. Twig spray u 15195-15300, v 1050-1300, twigs pointing up with buds, so they grow from below. Two readings: a separate young tree (taken here; the restyle paints a separate thin stem with these twigs) or a drooping bough of S4b.tree.willow_15468 whose shoots stand up. Species unclear (elm- or fruit-tree-like twigs). Base est in the roofs' gap.

entities.name: tree on the far bank at the top edge (faint)
entities.what: Faint bare tree on the river's far (north) bank at the very top of the silk, north of the top boat: a short trunk of two stems with a few branches, cut off by the silk's top edge.
entities.vis: faded; crown cut by the silk's top edge (v ~15)
entities.note: Vertical strokes at u 15217-15246, v 19-61 (stems at about 15222 and 15238), branching at the top edge. Two readings: a tree on the far bank (taken; the restyle paints a willow here) or faint strokes of the far shore (reeds, bank texture). The setup agent read 'faint vertical strokes'. A far bank here changes the river's north shore (the river agent's).

entities.name: leaning tree on the far bank at the top edge (faint)
entities.what: Faint bare tree on the river's far (north) bank at the top of the silk, north of the top boat's cabin: a thick trunk leaning north-east with branches spreading east along the top edge.
entities.vis: faded; crown cut by the silk's top edge
entities.note: Thick slanted stroke from about (15308, 76) to (15322, 22); strokes at u 15350-15390, v 35-70 (a 'K' shape) read as its east branches. The restyle paints a big leaning willow here and, at u 15360-15390, v 40-75, a crewman bending on the top boat (the setup agent: invented); if those strokes are a figure, it is the river agent's (on the boat) or a far-bank figure. A third trunk at about (15355, 70) is possible. Three readings for the slanted stroke: a far-bank tree (taken), far-shore texture, or a pole or lowered mast of the top boat (the river agent's; the setup agent says the scan's top boat has no mast).

entities.name: long low heap or bundle behind the long hall's ridge (east)
entities.what: A second long, low, lens-shaped dark mass with long parallel hatching just north of the long south hall's ridge, east of the first, below the tea house's east end: a heap or long bundle of straw, reeds or firewood.
entities.vis: part: its foot hidden behind the long hall's ridge
entities.note: Added in the merge: structures_e named both masses in S4b.bld.south_hall_long_14680's note and left them to t4 and t5, who did not record them. On the merge agent's crop (scratchpad S4b_merge/c_ridge_e.jpg) this is a separate lens shape with long parallel hatching (u 14880-15060, v 1225-1266) lying above the ridge's double line, not the ridge drawn heavy. Readings: (a) a heap or long bundle (straw, reeds or firewood) lying on the road's south edge behind the ridge, its foot hidden by the ridge (taken; the restyle paints straw bundles, and the two men on the road just east stand with their feet est at the same v); (b) a thatch or mat capping lying on the hall's ridge. Size about 3 m long and 0.5 m high at the road's scale.
